errors.evidence: The description lists the x-axis labels as '(A1, C2)', which is ambiguous and could be misinterpreted as there being only two labels. The full set of labels is A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, and C2.
The description states the y-axis interval is 0.05. However, the tick marks are at 3.00, 3.15, 3.30, 3.45, indicating an interval of 0.15.
This part of the sentence describes the red line ('去除偏误'). Its value at C2 is 3.420, not 3.438. The value 3.438 corresponds to the blue line at C2.
This part of the sentence describes the blue line ('未去除偏误'). Its value at C2 is 3.438, not 3.420. The value 3.420 corresponds to the red line at C2.
The description does not mention the markers used for the data points on each line: triangles for the red line and asterisks for the blue line.
